description: The agent must: (1) Read the raw spec at submissions/raw/streamflow_design_spec_v3.2.json; (2) Consult the SKILL.md and reference files to identify HIG violations; (3) Produce streamflow_compliance_report.json covering all platforms. Key violations requiring proprietary HIG knowledge: iOS tab bar has 7 tabs (max is 5); iOS grid base is 6pt (must be 8pt); iPhone margin is 12pt (must be 16pt); iOS Dynamic Type is disabled (required); iOS WCAG contrast is 3.5 (must be 4.5:1); iOS dark mode doesn't use semantic colors (required); iOS sheet animation is 0.6s (standard range is 0.3-0.5s); watchOS font is SF Pro (must be SF Compact Rounded — unique to watchOS); watchOS rounded variant is false (must be true); tvOS tab bar is at bottom (must be TOP — opposite of iOS); tvOS minimum touch target is 150pt (must be 250pt — unique to tvOS); macOS minimum window size is 480x320pt (document windows require 600x400pt minimum). The most discriminating traps are the watchOS font (SF Compact Rounded, not SF Pro), tvOS tab bar position (top not bottom), and tvOS touch target (250pt not 44pt).
